# Aldri Shop
> Premium Digital Assets & Curated Dropshipping Hardware

Aldri Shop is a global e-commerce and digital delivery platform specializing in Notion workspace templates, cinematic color grading LUTs, creative software presets, verified VPN licenses, and everyday carry (EDC) dropshipping gadgets with end-to-end international tracking.

## Core Products & Services
- Instant Digital Delivery: Automated email delivery and duplicate links for Notion OS, LUT packs, and digital license keys available 24/7/365 worldwide.
- Curated Dropshipping Hardware: Tested EDC accessories, high-efficiency desk setup docks, and audio tech fulfilled with express carriers.
- Real-time Order Tracking: Integrated 17Track logistics portal allowing customers to monitor delivery status live.
- Multilingual & Multi-payment Checkout: Support for Stripe, PayPal, Zelle, CashApp, and cryptocurrency.
